label: Life expectancy at birth
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = UN DYB Table 4, national official statistics as reported, 13 editions (2015 recovered v10), 2007-2024, sex-split (Male/Female) as printed by the collector; witness tier = OWID "life expectancy" (the mixed long-run compilation — Riley, HMD, UN WPP — both sexes) and the World Bank SP.DYN.LE00.MA/FE codes (pure UN WPP, sex-split), near-global. Authenticity first per ADR-0008: displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): UN DYB = UN data reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); OWID witness = CC-BY-4.0; World Bank witness = CC-BY-4.0.
notes:
THE SEX DIMENSION (the honest cost of the as-reported route): the DYB collector prints life expectancy at birth for Male and Female separately — there is no "both sexes" column to report, and averaging the two would be a derivation (the canonical tier reports, it does not derive). Every canonical point therefore carries sex="male"|"female" and (entity, year, sex) is the merge key. The OWID witness is both-sexes: it stays comparable at the SERIES level (its both-sexes level sits between the two canonical curves), not pointwise. Since v11 the World Bank witnesses ARE sex-split (SP.DYN.LE00.MA/FE): the male/female witness curves the sex-split canonical lacked — the Russian sex gap in life expectancy, one of Todd's standing exhibits, can now be read collector-vs-model curve to curve, not only against a both-sexes line. A both-sexes canonical series would be a derived product, explicitly out of scope until a separate decision says otherwise.
CANONICAL TIER: un_dyb Table 4, editions 2011-2015 + 2017-2024 (the 2015 vintage recovered in v10 via the legacy URL pattern) — as-reported LE at birth over 2007-2024, overlapping windows reconstructed edition by edition, intra-tier arbitration (later vintage wins, logged in provenance.json). Collector holes are data: countries absent from the table's windows (no questionnaire response or no civil-registration LE that year) stay absent — Russia included, which is why the WPP witness (WB codes) carries Russia's full series where the collector freezes. The pre-2007 as-reported history lives in the PDF-era editions — deliberately NOT in this loop (ADR-0007's PDF-route gate).
WITNESS TIER: two DIFFERENT harmonized roots, deliberately both wired: - owid `life-expectancy` — "over the long-run" series combining
  historical reconstructions (Riley, HMD) with UN WPP estimates,
  methodologically heterogeneous by period (root:
  owid_longrun_composite); check n_missing_within_span per country in
  reports/coverage_report.md before using this series for a given
  country over a long span.
- worldbank SP.DYN.LE00.MA.IN / SP.DYN.LE00.FE.IN — pure UN WPP
  (root: un_wpp), sex-split, 1960-2024, rounded to one decimal (the
  WDI print). Where the two witnesses disagree, the difference is the
  Riley/HMD-vs-WPP genealogy showing — display material, not an error
  to reconcile.

Life expectancy at 60 is its own indicator since v10 (life_expectancy_60, DYB Tables 21/22 + a GHO witness) — see its config for the cross-section semantics of the by-age tables.
